summary: Readers count a consumer's local delivery, read and close marks beside message lifecycle claims (db break-up step 4b, readers first)

replay.detail: No claim, replication or replay changes. A mark is local to its member, never replicated and outside every digest; nothing in this release writes one.

schema.detail: The graph's user_version is unchanged. A new member-local table, local_message_marks, and its triggers are created on open; the idle-mail fold triggers are renamed to v3 so an existing store takes the new fold. The shared message_index and the projection digest are unchanged.

rules.detail: Message lifecycle rules are unchanged. A reader decides one state per message: its lifecycle claims or its marks, whichever is further along.

compatibility.detail: Message views, mailbox pages, unread and idle mail, coordination holds, client selectors, wake evidence, attention targets, handoff acknowledgements, the mail-backlog check and delivery probes read local_message_marks beside lifecycle claims. A backup that carries marks is version 4 (it lists local_message_marks among its ledgers); a build older than this release refuses to restore it with 'unsupported claim backup format/version'. Backups taken on this release restore on this release or later. This release writes no marks, so its backups stay at their earlier versions.

downtime.detail: No migration. The hourly local trim also removes marks a further-along record supersedes after seven days, and those of messages this member no longer holds.

recovery.detail: Rolling back to the previous release is safe: it ignores local_message_marks and reads its own lifecycle claims. Once a later release records marks, a rollback below this one shows the messages those marks cover as undelivered, and a version 4 backup does not restore there.
